{{Top|leg}}
A '''subspace radio antenna''' was a horseshoe-shaped [[Magnet/Legends|magnet]] wrapped in layers of super-conductive wire, used to generate the intense magnetic fields required to send [[Subspace transceiver/Legends|subspace transmissions]]. The wire used to wrap the magnet was exceptionally thin, requiring over ten [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] of wire to fully cover the U-shaped frame.
